assessment: This study bridges the gap between connectomic data from the fly hemibrain and driver lines needed for functional experiments. The large collection of labeled single cells clones from a large number of samples now provides the community to search both light microscopic and electron microscopic databases for matches using single cells, or cell types. Overall, this manuscript does a compelling job of describing an important resource for the community, which will hopefully be built upon via the collaborative science of many groups as the field develops.
